'''Alaric's palace''' was a [[Castle/Legends|castle]] in which [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]], [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]], lived in the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It contained a bountiful [[Alaric's garden|garden]] that was a source of pride to its owner. One of the palace most prominent features was a [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]]-shaped tower, the facade of which contained many ogive [[Window/Legends|windows]]. Several wings projected from and were subordinate to the main building, including the north wing, which contained a vast corridor. There were several entrances to the palace, including the east gate. King Alaric's audience chamber was a vaulted room with a high ceiling. The monarch sat on his [[Throne/Legends|throne]] at the far end of the room, with his back to the wide windows.<ref name="JY" />
